summary: Completed and verified the four open findings; the working tree already contained the code for each from this attempt, so no further source rewrite was needed. REV-1 (R5): UI/zestIcons.tsx:160-165 looks up icons with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call and returns null for inherited names such as __proto__, constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty and valueOf, so an untrusted name renders nothing and never throws; __tests__/ZestIcon.test.tsx:68-80 covers those names. REV-2 (EFF-001): the two unused duplicate arrow constants are gone, export/download and import/upload share one element each, leftover development comments are gone, and a fresh rollup build measures dist/index.esm.js at 79,993 bytes against the 65,106-byte baseline, a 14,887-byte delta under the 15,000-byte cap. REV-3 (DOC-001): UI/zestIcons.tsx:93 draws three vertical slider tracks with round knobs for settings and documentation/features.md:147 describes that icon as 'Sliders'. REV-4 (USR-003): every icon constant in UI/zestIcons.tsx is referenced by the 35-entry drawing set and the 47-name map, and the file contains no comments or dead duplicates. Build, type check and the full library suite pass: 18 suites, 224 tests.
